## Summary

<!--
Bullet points, most important first. Bold lead-in per bullet works well for
scanning, e.g.:
  - **Root cause of X** — one or two sentences on why it happened, not just what changed.
  - **Y added** — what it does and why, in plain terms.
Group with an app-name sub-header (### Scrybe / ### Shelf Snap / ### PriceDrop)
when a PR touches more than one app and the changes aren't the same across them.
Prefer explaining *why* over restating the diff — reviewers can already see
the diff; they can't see the reasoning that led to it.
-->
